# Здоровье Mail (Health.mail.ru)

> Comprehensive Russian health portal providing medical news, disease information, drug references, and expert doctor consultations.

Health.mail.ru is a major Russian health information platform operated by Mail.ru Group, offering evidence-based medical content including articles on diseases, medications, nutrition, wellness, and access to medical professionals. The site aggregates content from leading medical institutions and healthcare experts.

## Key Topics

- Medical News
- Diseases & Symptoms
- Medications & Drugs
- Doctor Consultations
- Nutrition & Diet
- Wellness & Lifestyle
- Preventive Health
- Medical Institutions
- Health Articles
- Diagnostic Procedures
- Pregnancy & Maternal Health
- Cardiovascular Health
- Oncology
- Gastroenterology
- Eye Health

## Core Health Resources

- [Здоровье Mail: новости медицины, все о болезнях и лекарствах, консультации врачей](https://health.mail.ru): Health.mail.ru homepage: medical news, diseases, drugs, expert advice
- [Статьи - Здоровье Mail](https://health.mail.ru/article): Health articles collection covering nutrition, wellness, genetics

## Medical Information Sections

- [Болезни](https://health.mail.ru/disease): Comprehensive disease database with symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment information
- [Лекарства](https://health.mail.ru/drug): Medication reference section with drug information, interactions, and usage guidelines
- [Медицинские новости](https://health.mail.ru/news): Latest medical news and health research updates

## Expert Services

- [Консультации врачей](https://health.mail.ru/consultation): Doctor consultation service providing expert medical advice from qualified professionals

## Health Topics & Collections

- [Как защитить глаза весной](https://health.mail.ru/article/3945620-kak-zashchitit-glaza-vesnoy): Article on spring eye protection and seasonal eye health
- [Какие симптомы могут указывать на рак желудка](https://health.mail.ru/article/3945588-kakie-simptomy-mogut-ukazyvat-na-rak-zheludka): Article on stomach cancer symptoms and early warning signs
- [Острая пища и желудок](https://health.mail.ru/article/3945521-ostraya-pishcha-i-zheludok): Article on spicy food and stomach health effects
- [Что такое гарвардская тарелка](https://health.mail.ru/article/3496588-chto-takoe-garvardskaya-tarelka): Article on Harvard plate nutrition model for balanced diet
- [Беременность при ожирении](https://health.mail.ru/article/3945431-beremennost-pri-ozhirenii): Article on pregnancy and obesity health considerations
- [Как распознать микроинсульт](https://health.mail.ru/news/3945621-kak-raspoznat-mikroinsult): Article on recognizing microstrokes and warning symptoms
- [С чем можно спутать почечную колику](https://health.mail.ru/article/3945589-s-chem-mozhno-sputat-pochechnuyu-koliku): Article on kidney colic symptoms and differential diagnosis
- [Сидеть на унитазе больше 5 минут](https://health.mail.ru/article/3945555-sidet-na-unitaze-bolshe-5-minut): Article on toilet time health effects and digestive health
- [Опасно ли МРТ](https://health.mail.ru/news/3945553-opasno-li-mrt): Article on MRI safety and radiation concerns

## News Categories

- [Новости образа жизни](https://health.mail.ru/news/list/life): Lifestyle news section covering wellness and daily health practices
- [Новости питания и диеты](https://health.mail.ru/news/list/eating): Nutrition and diet news section with latest dietary research
- [Коллекции - Жиры](https://health.mail.ru/collections/fat): Nutrition collection focused on fats and lipid health
